title: AI Engineer
description:
The AI Engineer plays a critical role in making modeling and simulation accessible to non-data scientists. You will be designing, developing, and deploying AI-driven applications to make our software more accessible which will have a direct impact on the number of organizations we are able to serve. This position plays a critical role in our product roadmap and will directly contribute to the company's success and growth. Ideal candidates exhibit a high willingness to experiment and empathy for users.
About Epistemix
The most consequential decisions in public health, life sciences, insurance, and enterprise strategy share a common problem: they involve human behavior, network effects, and downstream effects that cannot be safely tested before action is taken. Traditional analytical techniques built on historical data were not built for this. Epistemix was.
We build simulation and data-driven modeling tools that let leaders visualize how strategies will unfold across populations and systems before they commit resources. By clarifying which variables drive outcomes, where leverage exists, and how they interact, we help organizations move from uncertainty to conviction. Getting these decisions right means faster interventions, better-allocated resources, and measurable improvements in human and economic outcomes. We exist to make that possible.
Our platform gives organizations access to realistic, high-resolution population data and the modeling infrastructure to run scenario planning at scale. Together, these capabilities let decision-makers stress-test strategies in a controlled environment before deploying them in the real world across healthcare, consumer industries, insurance, and government. We are approaching our Series B and actively building the team that will define what comes next.
Responsibilities

• Craft clean, testable, and maintainable code to enable AI-generated agent-based models.

• Own the software from requirements development through deployment and maintenance that enable decision makers to generate agent-based models that address critical business questions and data scientists to build agent-based models more quickly that answer the questions of decision makers.

• Design, build, test, and deploy a scalable system architecture so that AI-generated models can be validated by data scientists and deliver results back to decision makers quickly.

• Own the engineering solution and collaborate with internal teams to ensure alignment with company strategy.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field (or equivalent experience).

• 3+ years of experience developing AI/ML applications in production environments.

• Proven track record of working with LLMs, NLP models, or AI-driven systems.

• Experience designing and optimizing high-performance, scalable APIs.

• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

• Must be legally authorized to work in the United States and not require employer sponsorship now or in the future.

Required Skills

• Python - Advanced proficiency in writing clean, efficient, and scalable code.

• Pydantic - Strong experience in data validation, serialization, and structured model definition.

• LLM Evaluation - Ability to assess model performance, optimize outputs, and fine-tune AI behavior.

• Prompt Optimization - Expertise in crafting, refining, and iterating prompts for optimal AI performance.

• SQLAlchemy - Hands-on experience with database modeling, ORM techniques, and performance tuning.

• FastAPI - Proven ability to develop and maintain APIs with FastAPI for AI-driven applications.

Nice to Have Experience

• Experience with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, FAISS) for efficient AI retrieval.

• Familiarity with Docker & Kubernetes for containerized AI application deployment.

• Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure) for scaling AI infrastructu

title: Cyber Security Architect, Director
description:
Ankura is a team of excellence founded on innovation and growth.
Position Summary:
The Cloud Security Architect performs cloud security posture and configuration reviews to identify misconfigurations, security control gaps, support migrations, and opportunities for improvement. This role executes assessment workflows using CSPM-based approaches and delivers clear, prioritized recommendations aligned with client objectives and relevant standards. This is remote based in the United States.

Please note that this role requires permanent authorization to work in the U.S. (i.e. U.S. citizen or permanent resident).

Responsibilities:

• Conduct cloud configuration and security posture reviews using CSPM approaches and automated scanning methods aligned with Ankura cloud assessment practices.

• Assess cloud configurations against predefined requirements and map gaps to common standards and regulatory expectations referenced in client deliverables, such as NIST, ISO, and CIS.

• Analyze results and deliver client-ready reports that include prioritized remediation recommendations and actionable roadmaps.

• Support reviews across key cloud security domains commonly covered in cloud assessments, including identity and access, network segmentation, logging and monitoring, workload configuration, and security governance.

• Collaborate with engagement leads and stakeholders to validate findings and ensure recommendations are practical and aligned with the client’s operating model.

• Work with clients and business leaders to support statements of work (SOWs) and engagement delivery.

• Work cross-functionally with IT, engineering, and security stakeholders to drive adoption of cloud security controls and operational improvements.

Requirements:

• Bachelors degree or equivalent experience

• 3-5 years of relevant experience

• Cloud Certificate (Azure /AWS/GPC) required

• Experience delivering cloud security assessments for Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365, and/or AWS environments, including configuration analysis and remediation planning; experience with GCP and Oracle Cloud is a plus.

• Experience configuring Microsoft Copilot and Microsoft Purview is a plus.

• Strong written communication skills, with the ability to produce structured executive summaries and detailed findings and recommendations.

• Hands-on experience implementing, migrating, and operating security controls in Microsoft Azure and/or Microsoft 365 environments.

• Practical knowledge of identity and access management patterns in Microsoft cloud environments (for example, Entra ID and privileged access concepts).

• Experience implementing security governance and controls that support compliance and risk management expectations in cloud environments.

• Experience with CSPM tools and workflows used in cloud posture reviews, such as Prisma Cloud or Zscaler Posture Control is preferred.

• Experience with cloud security posture management and configuration review programs, including translating findings into prioritized remediation plans is preferred.

• Familiarity with security frameworks commonly used in cloud assessments, including NIST, ISO, and CIS mappings is preferred

• Willingness to travel as needed (approximately 25%)

• Please note that this role requires permanent authorization to work in the U.S. (i.e. U.S. citizen or permanent resident).

Ankura is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against based on disability. title: Senior Commercial Counsel
description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

Deepgram is the leading platform underpinning the emerging trillion-dollar Voice AI economy, providing real-time APIs for speech-to-text (STT), text-to-speech (TTS), and building production-grade voice agents at scale. More than 200,000 developers and 1,300+ organizations build voice offerings that are ‘Powered by Deepgram’, including Twilio, Cloudflare, Sierra, Decagon, Vapi, Daily, Cresta, Granola, and Jack in the Box. Deepgram’s voice-native foundation models are accessed through cloud APIs or as self-hosted and on-premises software, with unmatched accuracy, low latency, and cost efficiency. Backed by a recent Series C led by leading global investors and strategic partners, Deepgram has processed over 50,000 years of audio and transcribed more than 1 trillion words. There is no organization in the world that understands voice better than Deepgram.

COMPANY OPERATING RHYTHM

At Deepgram, we expect an AI-first mindset-AI use and comfort aren’t optional, they’re core to how we operate, innovate, and measure performance.

Every team member who works at Deepgram is expected to actively use and experiment with advanced AI tools, and even build your own into your everyday work. We measure how effectively AI is applied to deliver results, and consistent, creative use of the latest AI capabilities is key to success here. Candidates should be comfortable adopting new models and modes quickly, integrating AI into their workflows, and continuously pushing the boundaries of what these technologies can do.

Additionally, we move at the pace of AI. Change is rapid, and you can expect your day-to-day work to evolve just as quickly. This may not be the right role if you’re not excited to experiment, adapt, think on your feet, and learn constantly, or if you’re seeking something highly prescriptive with a traditional 9-to-5.

Opportunity:

We’re looking for an exceptional commercial lawyer to join our lean, high-impact legal team as our second commercial lawyer. This role is for someone who thrives at the intersection of law and business strategy - a deal-maker with sharp instincts, sound judgment, and genuine excitement about what Deepgram is building and how we are changing what is possible with speech.

Our legal team has a real seat at the table. You’ll close deals that matter, shape legal strategy at the frontier of AI, and craft commercial frameworks that are being built for the first time in this space. You’ll also help establish a legal function that scales with a company on a steep trajectory, reporting directly to our AssociateGeneral Counsel (Commercial). This role will be based in the UK/EU and will play a lead role in supporting our growing UK/EU and APAC business, including our expanding presence in the UK, EU, India, Australia, and Singapore.

This is a role for a builder.

What You’ll Do

- Structure, negotiate, and close enterprise sales and partnership agreements, along with supporting a range of other commercial deals (including vendor and services agreements, data licenses, and marketing arrangements)

- Serve as a trusted partner to our sales and business development teams, helping them move faster and smarter

- Bring customer empathy to every negotiation, understanding the businesses we serve well enough to craft agreements that close faster and hold up longer

- Design and implement scalable legal processes - standardizing deal terms, building templates, and streamlining the path to signed agreement

- Provide clear, practical guidance on privacy, intellectual property, data security, and AI-specific legal issues as they arise

- Navigate cross-border commercial and regulatory issues across the UK/EU and APAC and structure appropriate data transfer mechanisms (SCCs, adequacy decisions, BCRs) for our voice data processing

- Stay ahead of the evolving legal landscape for AI technologies and their impact on customers, translating developments into actionable guidance for our teams

title: Podcast Video Editor - SaaS
description:
Position: Podcast Video Editor
Number of hours: Project Based
Schedule: Flexible
About the Project
We're producing a high-quality, YouTube-first legal podcast and looking for a video editor who lives and breathes the Diary of a CEO style - clean cuts, dynamic pacing, strong visual storytelling, and a polished finish that keeps viewers watching. Think tight pacing, purposeful B-roll use, graphic overlays where appropriate, and an eye for social-worthy moments.
What You'll Do

• Sync and assemble multi-camera footage into a compelling full-length episode (typically 60-90 minutes).

• Clean and balance dialogue audio.

• Trim dead air and tighten pacing without losing the natural flow of conversation.

• Label and rough-cut 4-6 strong social clip moments within the timeline.

• Build rough timelines for vertical social cutdowns (final polish handled internally).

• Maintain an organized Premiere project structure that our internal team can easily pick up for final polish, packaging, and distribution.

What We're Looking For

• Demonstrable experience editing long-form podcast content in a Diary of a CEO , Huberman Lab, or similar premium YouTube podcast style. (must requirement sample)

• Strong proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro; experience with Autopod for multi-cam sync is a plus.

• Working knowledge of dialogue cleanup and audio balancing.

• Comfortable working within an established workflow and receiving structured, direct feedback.

• Reliable high-speed internet connection.

• Adequate local storage capacity to manage large 4K media files.

The Engagement
We're starting with a single episode edit - estimated 2-4 hours for an experienced editor. Strong candidates will be considered for ongoing work as the show grows. This is a great opportunity to build a long-term creative partnership from the ground up.
How to Apply?
To apply, please carefully follow the instructions below.

• Email Subject Line Format

Use this exact format in your email subject line:
RBS Hire Me! Podcast Video Editor_Full Name_Country
Then send to:
Example:
RBS Hire Me! Podcast Video Editor_Juan Cox_United States

• Required Documents & Materials

Please attach and include the following in your email:

•
Updated CV / Resume

• Clearly list your previous roles.

• Include your key responsibilities for each position.

• Your hourly rate

•
Updated Portfolio

• Provide a direct link to your portfolio (Google Drive, personal website, etc.).

• Ensure all links are accessible for viewing (no restricted access).

• Include only your best and most relevant editing projects , especially podcast-related work.

•
Cover Letter
In your cover letter, briefly explain:

• Your specific role in each project

• The tools and software you used (e.g., editing software, plugins, workflow tools)

• Your editing approach or creative process

•
Sample Works
• Please provide links to 2-3 examples of long-form podcast episodes you have edited.

Bonus! Include examples of short-form social media clips you created from longer podcast content.
IMPORTANT NOTE: Only applications that follow all the instructions above will be reviewed.
This is a remote position open to candidates worldwide. Initial engagement is for one episode; strong candidates may be considered for a long-term role.

title: Narrative Writer
description:
About us
At Longdue , we’re dedicated to crafting narrative-first, psychologically deep, RPGs.
We focus on creating games with real depth-whether in our characters, environments or the stories we tell. We’re here to challenge your choices, your morality-everything you think you know. We’re here to make games where decisions matter and have consequences. We want to build on the legacy of classic story-driven RPGs while reviving the genre meaningfully.
Our goal is simple: to become a trusted name in the greater RPG canon.
With talent from the original Disco Elysium team and veterans from the wider industry, including Bungie and Rockstar, we’re creating something new-a project that resonates, challenges, and leaves a lasting mark.
We’re Longdue , and we’re finally here.
The role
We are seeking a talented Writer to help craft an immersive, multi-layered RPG experience for our computer RPG in its early stages. The gameplay will focus on dialogue choices, character interactions, and a branching story where every decision has consequences. You’ll be responsible for creating narrative content that combines psychological depth, philosophical musings, and a richly evocative world that brings player choices to life.
Responsibilities

• Write compelling dialogue and narrative events that deepen the connection between characters and the world.

• Develop a rich story that explores the interplay between the physical environment and the protagonist’s mental journey.

• Contribute to building a universe awash in contrasts, where environments from two interconnected worlds reflect each other in direct and mysterious ways.

• Collaborate with designers, artists, programmers, and your colleagues in narrative to ensure the story is deeply integrated with gameplay, emphasising role-play and skill-based checks inspired by TTRPG mechanics.

Requirements

Must-have

• Proven experience in writing for video games, especially RPGs or interactive fiction. Creative writing or screenwriting experience is also highly valued.

• Ability to craft a story that explores themes of psychogeography, human psychology, and the dark corners of society. We want characters and dialogue that are multifaceted, flawed, and profoundly human.

• Ability to develop environments that reflect the character’s internal state, exploring connections between space, mood, and psychology.

• An interest in delving into cosmic mysteries, existential questions, and philosophical ideas about society, power, and individual purpose.

• Capable of working within a creative team, taking feedback constructively, and contributing to the shared vision of the project.

Nice to have

• Familiarity with narrative-heavy RPGs.

• Experience in crafting non-combat gameplay loops that revolve around storytelling, exploration, and character development.

• Knowledge of TTRPG-inspired mechanics such as dialogue reels, dice-based checks, or psychological skill systems.

• Experience writing in media other than video games.

Benefits
Creative freedom: We foster an environment where your unique voice and vision can shape a groundbreaking RPG.
Thought-provoking project: Help create a game that challenges conventions, offers a deep philosophical experience, and invites players to explore not only a mysterious world but also the depths of the human psyche.
Flexible working: We are a remote-first studio, offering you the freedom to work from wherever inspiration strikes.
Join Us: We’re here to make narrative-first, psychologically deep RPGs. If you’re passionate about storytelling, design, and pushing the boundaries of what games can be, Longdue is the place for you.

title: Solutions Engineer
description:
PlanetScale is growing rapidly and reinventing the transactional database market. The PlanetScale platform offers both Postgres and Vitess clusters. Vitess, an open-source database clustering system for horizontal scaling of MySQL, enables businesses to efficiently handle large-scale data workloads - without sacrificing developer experience.
PlanetScale is backed with over $100M in venture financing from top-tier VCs including a16z, Kleiner Perkins, SignalFire, and Insight Venture Partners. And we serve some of the most innovative companies in the world such as Block, Anysphere (Cursor), MyFitnessPal, Etsy, Kick, and thousands more. Our customers entrust us with what is often their most precious digital asset, their data, so the stakes couldn't be higher. We're looking for early members of our Sales team that can form deep partnerships with our prospects and customers to help them adopt and succeed on the next generation of database infrastructure.
What's the job to be done?

• Partner with Sales and Customer Engineering throughout the pre-sales and post-sales journey as the technical expert helping customers solve their most challenging database problems.

• Lead technical discovery to match customers’ business and technical objectives with PlanetScale ’s offerings.

• Design and execute proof of value timelines that deliver on agreed upon business outcomes and success criteria.

• Design database migration strategies and work hands-on with customers to execute migrations to PlanetScale 's PostgreSQL and Vitess platforms.

• Assess workloads, analyze performance requirements, and recommend architecture, sizing, and optimization strategies.

• Build tools, scripts, and automation that accelerate migrations and improve customer onboarding.

• Create educational content including documentation, guides, blog posts, workshops, and videos.

• Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to advocate for customer needs and shape the platform.

These attributes best describe you…

• You have deep expertise in database systems including replication, high availability, sharding, performance tuning, and migration strategies.

• You're equally comfortable presenting architecture designs to executives and writing scripts to automate migration tasks.

• You thrive in customer-facing situations and translate technical concepts into business value for diverse audiences.

• You're self-motivated and can manage multiple engagements simultaneously with minimal oversight.

• You enjoy creating content and sharing knowledge through various formats.

• You're comfortable with occasional travel (less than 20%).

What you will need

• 5+ years of hands-on experience with MySQL or PostgreSQL in production, including operations, performance tuning, and troubleshooting OR

• 5+ years of experience supporting customers with MySQL or PostgreSQL workloads where you advised on operations, performance tuning, and troubleshooting

• Experience working with at least one major cloud provider (AWS, GCP, Azure, or OCI)

• Proven success in customer-facing technical roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, or Technical Account Manager

• Strong understanding of database migration strategies and tooling

• Experience evaluating database solutions including architecture reviews, capacity planning, and performance analysis

• Ability to write scripts and tools in Python, Go, or JavaScript

• Experience creating technical content such as documentation, tutorials, or blog posts

What else will help you be successful

• Experience with AWS Database Migration Service (DMS) or logical replication tools

• Knowledge of Vitess, database sharding, or distributed database systems

• Familiarity with Kubernetes and cloud-native architectures

• Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools like Terraform or CloudFormation

• Contributions to open-source projects or active participation in database communities

• Public speaking experience at conferences or meetups

description:
About Rivet
Rivet is an American company building integrated task systems - fusing hardened hardware with software, sensors, AI, and networking - for industrial workforces and defense personnel. We create capabilities that multiply the effectiveness of every individual and withstand the world’s toughest environments.

We serve the people who build, operate, maintain, and defend our way of life. Work Authorization Requirement: Due to the nature of our business and compliance with federal regulations, all candidates must be a "U.S. Person". Upon hire, you will be required to provide documentation verifying your status as a U.S. Citizen, a lawful permanent resident, or a protected individual under 8 U.S.C. 1324b(a)(3).

Summary

Rivet is looking for a hands-on Senior Software Engineer to own perceptual calibration for our next-generation AR wearables and devices running Android and embedded Linux. Accurate camera, IMU, and display calibration is what every tracking and display experience rests on: it keeps tracking stable, overlays registered to the real world, and rendering comfortable. This role spans calibration algorithms, calibration station and process design, and factory deployment, taking calibration from the lab bench to factory production lines. You will work closely with hardware, mechanical, robotics, perception, and manufacturing teams to deliver calibration that is accurate, repeatable, and efficient at production scale.

Responsibilities

- Build computer vision and signal processing algorithms that calibrate the geometric intrinsics, extrinsics, and time offsets of cameras, IMUs, and XR displays.

- Develop perceptual calibration processes for Rivet’s range of wearables and devices, covering calibration station design (sensor and target selection, metrology hardware requirements) and controlled data capture conditions.

- Deploy data capture processes and calibration binaries to factory sites, working with contract manufacturers (CMs) through bring-up, ramp, and mass production.

- Set factory calibration limits using Gage Repeatability & Reproducibility (GR&R) studies and Design of Experiments (DOE), and establish failure analysis processes backed by automated and agentic diagnosis and documented runbooks.

- Reduce calibration cycle time through software profiling and refinement, additional or alternative station hardware, and process pipelining.

- Develop tooling, visualization, and debugging workflows for end-to-end validation of perceptual calibration, including lab verification of factory calibration results.

- Partner with hardware, mechanical, optical, and electrical engineering, robotics, perception, and manufacturing teams to set calibration requirements, design-for-calibration tolerances, and station specifications, and to deliver calibrated products end-to-end.

Requirements

- Proven hands-on experience shipping camera, IMU, and/or display calibration solutions into production devices, from lab prototype through factory ramp.

- Demonstrated hands-on ability to debug calibration failures, with a deep understanding of both the front-end perception (target detection, feature extraction, data association) and back-end optimization (sensor models, nonlinear least squares, observability) components of geometric calibration pipelines.

- PhD + at least 3 years (or MS + at least 7 years) of relevant professional experie

title: Sr IT Cyber Defense Analyst
description:
Senior IT Cyber Defense Analyst (Shift Lead)
AI-Enabled Security Operations | 24/7 SOC
Location: Remote - Pune/Baroda, India
Department: IT Cybersecurity - Security Operations Center (SOC)
Reports To: SOC Manager
Work Schedule: 24/7 rotational shifts
About the Role
We are seeking an experienced Senior IT Cyber Defense Analyst (Shift Lead) to lead day-to-day SOC operations, oversee security investigations, coordinate incident response, and mentor SOC analysts. The ideal candidate will bring strong SIEM/EDR expertise, advanced threat investigation skills, and hands-on experience using AI/LLM tools and automation to improve SOC efficiency and detection capabilities.
Key Responsibilities

• Lead SOC shift operations, prioritize alerts, manage escalations, and ensure timely handovers and SLA adherence.

• Investigate complex incidents involving phishing, malware, ransomware, compromised accounts, endpoint threats, and suspicious network activity.

• Conduct threat hunting, correlate security telemetry, and map attacker behavior to the MITRE ATT&CK framework.

• Develop, optimize, and troubleshoot SIEM queries, analytics rules, and detection use cases using Microsoft Sentinel and KQL.

• Use approved AI/LLM tools for alert triage, investigation assistance, threat intelligence enrichment, KQL development, incident reporting, and workflow automation; independently validate AI-generated outputs.

• Automate repetitive SOC tasks using Python, PowerShell, APIs, or SOAR capabilities.

• Mentor analysts, improve investigation quality, reduce false positives, and maintain accurate incident documentation and audit-ready evidence.

• Coordinate with Incident Response, IT, Endpoint, Network, and Cloud teams to support containment, remediation, and recovery.

Required Skills and Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.

• 5+ years of experience in SOC, cyber defense, or incident response, including shift leadership, incident coordination, or analyst mentoring.

• Strong hands-on experience with SIEM, EDR/XDR, incident investigation, and threat detection.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Sentinel and KQL; experience with Microsoft Defender, CrowdStrike, or similar security platforms.

• Strong understanding of networking, Windows/Linux, identity security, email threats, and MITRE ATT&CK.

• Mandatory practical AI/LLM proficiency, including prompt engineering, AI-assisted investigations, validation of AI-generated queries/scripts, and awareness of hallucinations, prompt injection, and data privacy risks.

• Scripting or automation experience using Python, PowerShell, APIs, or SOAR tools.

• Strong analytical, communication, decision-making, and team leadership skills; willingness to work in a 24/7 rotational shift environment.

Preferred Qualifications

• Certifications such as Microsoft SC-200, CompTIA CySA+, GCIH, or relevant SIEM/EDR vendor certifications.

• Experience in proactive threat hunting, detection engineering, cloud security, and SOC process improvement.

What Success Looks Like

• Effective shift leadership and timely, high-quality incident handling.

• Improved detection coverage, investigation efficiency, and reduced false positives.

• Practical adoption of AI and automation to reduce repetitive work while maintaining security, accuracy, and human oversight.

• Strong analyst development, documentation, and operational consistency.

OpenAI’s Compute organization builds the infrastructure that powers frontier AI training and inference. This work brings together commercial, technical, strategy, and operations teams to secure and develop the sites and capacity needed for large-scale compute deployment.

We partner across real estate, power, engineering, legal, finance, and delivery to connect infrastructure needs with viable development opportunities and executable commercial agreements.

We’re looking for a commercial real estate (CRE) development professional to help secure land and data-center capacity for OpenAI’s compute infrastructure. The ideal candidate is particularly strong in land and can also contribute across data-center transactions.

title: QA Engineer
description:
This is a remote position.
We're looking for a QA Engineer who is equal parts hands-on tester and automation advocate. You'll own quality for a large, complex mobile platform, and you'll do it by combining sharp exploratory and manual testing with a relentless push to automate the right things at the right layer.
This is not a role that sits at the end of the pipeline writing test cases. You'll work to shift testing left with developers, product, and design from the moment a story is shaped, help teams move away from a top-heavy, E2E-dependent suite toward a balanced testing model, and hold engineering teams accountable for the coverage they own. You'll build and scale the automation framework, but just as importantly you'll influence where tests live - pushing coverage down into unit, component, and contract layers so that the E2E suite stays small, fast, and trustworthy.
You'll also use AI-augmented tooling to accelerate test design, triage, and automation development, and you'll bring ideas for how quality engineering should evolve across a distributed, multi-team environment.

Requirements

• 5+ years of professional QA / quality engineering experience, with strong depth in both manual and automation testing.
• Strong understanding of QA principles, testing methodologies, and QA processes across the SDLC/STLC.
• Strong experience in test case design and testing native Android and iOS mobile applications.
• Hands-on experience with Appium and Cucumber; Java strongly preferred (our stack is Appium + Java + Cucumber + BrowserStack).
• Experience in integration testing and API automation, with the ability to design, develop, and maintain automated integration test suites.
• Experience designing, maintaining, and scaling automation frameworks - not just writing tests inside someone else's framework.
• Demonstrated judgment about test placement: knowing what belongs where being able to argue for it.
• Track record of influencing engineering teams toward automation by driving adoption, setting standards, and holding others accountable without formal authority.
• Comfortable using AI tools (e.g., Claude Code) to improve QA productivity, test design, and automation development.
• Ability to bring innovative ideas that improve quality, accelerate testing, and increase automation coverage.
• Good working knowledge of Jira.
• Strong analytical, debugging, and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent communication and collaboration skills, including working effectively with distributed and vendor teams.

Desirable

• Experience with contract testing and service virtualization / API mocking (e.g. Microcks).
• Experience with performance, accessibility, or security testing for mobile applications.
• Experience testing applications backed by a BFF or microservices architecture.
• Experience with feature flags, progressive rollouts, and testing in production-like conditions.
• Familiarity with mobile release processes, app store submission, and staged rollouts.
• Experience with observability tooling and using logs, traces, and crash analytics to investigate defects.
• Experience with headless CMS or content-driven applications.

title: Account Executive - Helsinki
description:
ABOUT US

Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights.

Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi.

About the Role

We're looking for a natural Sales person who is passionate about hospitality. Sales is at the heart of our business growth right now, and you will be driving it forward in your day-to-day. This role is about more than closing deals, it is about blending with the hospitality scene and winning the market.

In your day-to-day you can expect a mix of top of funnel activities, field sales, cold sales, networking, events and more.

What You’ll Do

Our sales are not your typical SaaS or office sales. We meet our customers where they operate:

- Find the coolest new hospitality spots in town that everyone talks about

- Create engaging ways to show our product

- Use creative communication strategies to close the deal that will help the merchant operate smarter

- Do a smooth handover to the onboarding team to make sure we go live quickly and successfully

- Efficiently use our CRM and other Sales tools (Hubspot, Clay, AI) to leave more time for creativity and connection

- Continuously improve and revisit our sales funnel

- Keep an eye on the new developments in the industry and the merchants needs to create our own path

What You’ll Need

You are a natural relationship builder with a passion for hospitality industry:

- Hands-on approach, independence and hunger for fast-paced operations

- Natural curiosity and a healthy appetite for calculated risk - we want you to try new things and not be afraid to fail

- Strong and engaging communication skills - you can grab an attention of a busy hospitality owner and keep them interested

- Passion and curiosity for hospitality and hospitality tech

- A minimum of 3 years of experience in Sales, Commercial Account Management or Hospitality

- You are comfortable working in both English and Finish

If this speaks to you we can be the right fit. Learn more about how we work from our Recipe here: https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers https://www.tebi.com/gb/careers.

Benefits:

- Start-up Equity

- Competitive Salary

- Flexible time off

- Team events

What is Restaurant Software?

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

How we use AI at Tebi

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

title: Redwood Finance Automation Solution Designer, Germany
description:
Redwood Finance Automation Solution Designer, Germany
Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Germany. Day rate: EUR 450 a day. Language: English.
The programme
An established organisation is automating its finance operations on Redwood Finance Automation. The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, account reconciliation, journal processing and the reporting that follows, all connected to the organisation's ERP.
You will own the solution design. You will work with the finance process owners to understand how the close runs today, decide what to automate and in what order, and set out a design the engineering team can build. You will then stay with that design through build, testing and go-live, and make the calls when what was designed meets what is real.
What you will work on
Current-state analysis of the record-to-report processes with controllers and finance operations leads. The target automation design across close, reconciliation, journals and intercompany, written up as the solution design. Decisions on what standard Redwood capability covers and where an extension is justified. The integration design with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and the other source systems. Balance sheet auto-certification rules, controls, approvals and audit trail designed into the solution, so the automated close stands up to audit. Guidance to the engineers through build, and review of what they deliver against the design. Test strategy and acceptance criteria with the finance users. A roadmap for the next waves of automation once the first processes are live.
What you bring
Solution design ownership on at least one live Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance) implementation, where you ran the design workshops and wrote the design yourself. 8 or more years in finance transformation, finance systems or record-to-report process design. A working understanding of SAP FI/CO, or the Oracle equivalent, and how close and reconciliation data flows between the ERP and the automation layer. Experience running workshops with finance users and turning what they say into a design that can be built and tested. The standing to work with senior finance stakeholders and hold a design position when it is challenged.
Useful but not essential:
Hands-on build experience on Redwood, so you know what your design asks of the engineers. BlackLine, Trintech, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. A finance qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or similar). Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls.
How to respond
Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood implementation: the finance processes in scope, the ERP it connected to, and which design decisions were yours.
About Yadimen
Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood Finance Automation people in front of the client.

title: Senior Manager, Growth Marketing Strategy & Operations
description:
Senior Manager, Strategy & Operations 

This is a hybrid position to the NYC HelloFresh Headquarters

About the role

The Senior Manager, Strategy & Operations is accountable for the business performance of Factor US’s Paid portfolio (conversions, CAC, and ROI) and for the operating rhythm behind it: the forecast, the executive reviews, and the testing roadmap.

You will…

• Own the business performance of the Paid portfolio against plan: diagnose variance in conversions, CAC, and ROI, and recommend the priorities in collaboration with Global paid media channel owners

• Partner with Global paid media resources to translate performance gaps into channel-level actions, and escalate when required

• Act as the Growth team’s liaison with Finance for accurate P&L forecasting: build and refresh forecasts, surface risks early, and keep reported spend reconciled.

• Drive executive reviews for Paid, including weekly business reviews, QBRs, and annual business planning. 

• Own the channel diversification and lift testing roadmap: prioritize tests, question the design standard, read out results, and convert them into budget moves.

• Manage spend allocation within approved budgets across the Paid portfolio, continuously shifting dollars toward efficiency and ROI.

• Direct the day-to-day work of the Manager, Growth Channels (dotted line), including weekly review preparation, paid spend compliance and reporting accuracy, and diversification initiatives.

• Mentor the Manager, Reactivations/RAF on strategy and ops rigor for React/RAF: forecasting, reviews, and analytical structure.

• Support Finance and Legal processes, including forecasting inputs and invoice approvals

• Use AI and automation to build reports, summarize performance, and speed up planning cycles.

You are…

• Accountable for outcomes you don’t directly execute: You get results from Global resources and a dotted-line team through clarity, credibility, and follow-through.

• A strategic operator: You build the system around the work (cadences, forecasts, test roadmaps), not just the analysis inside it.

• Analytical: You build forecasts, run retrospectives, and explain the story behind the numbers. You are fluent in CAC, CPA, CPM, CVR, LTV, and payback, and fast in Excel or Google Sheets.

• A coach: You develop managers through day-to-day direction and mentorship, and set a clear standard for rigor.

• A clear executive communicator: You write and present for Director, VP, and C-level audiences, with the answer first.

• Detail-oriented and results-driven: Forecasts reconcile, and measurable outcomes motivate you.

• Tech-forward: You actively use AI tools to work smarter.

At a minimum, you have…

• 8+ years in performance marketing or growth, with ownership of a multi-channel paid budget 

• Experience being accountable for paid performance results through partners or matrixed teams.

• Experience owning forecasts and partnering with Finance on P&L accuracy.

• Experience running executive reviews (WBR/MBR/QBR) and business planning.

• Experience coaching or mentoring other managers.

• Comfort using AI tools in analysis and reporting workflows.

You’ll get… 

• Competitive salary, 401k with company match that vests immediately upon participation

• Generous PTO, including sabbatical, and parental leave of up to 16 weeks

• Comprehensive health and wellness benefits with options at $0 monthly, effective first day of employment

• Tuition reimbursement for continuing education (upon 2 years of service)

• Up to 85% discount on subscriptions to HelloFresh meal plans (HelloFresh, Green Chef, Everyplate, and Factor_)   

• Access to Employee Resource Groups that are open to all employees, including those pertaining to BIPOC, women, veterans, parents, and LGBTQ+

• Inclusive, collaborative, and dynamic work environment within a fast-paced, mission-driven company that is disrupting the traditional food supply chain

We’re hiring a Field CTO with deep engineering experience to represent CodeRabbit’s technology and product vision with enterprise customers and the broader technical community. title: Marketing Lead
description: Über YLAB Wir bauen die KI, die wir unseren eigenen Kindern geben würden. Kinder wachsen heute mit KI auf. Wir sorgen dafür, dass diese KI neugierig macht statt süchtig, sicher ist statt datenhungrig und für Kinder gebaut wird statt für Erwachsene. Wir sind YLAB, ein kleines KI-Lab aus Köln-Ehrenfeld. Wir entwickeln Software und Hardware aus einer Hand, vom Sprachmodell bis zum Gehäuse. Unser erstes Produkt ist Onoo, ein Lernbegleiter ohne Bildschirm für Kinder ab vier. Onoo fragt zurück, lässt raten und denkt mit. Er hat keine Kamera und kein Display, zeigt keine Werbung und verkauft keine Daten. Warum YLAB Deine Arbeit landet im Kinderzimmer, nicht in einem Dashboard. Software & Hardware: KI, App, Firmware und Gerät entstehen bei uns zusammen. Du siehst, wie aus Code etwas wird, das ein Kind in die Hand nimmt. Du arbeitest an echten offenen Fragen, zum Beispiel wie KI Kinderstimmen versteht und Fünfjährigen die Welt erklärt. Tech, Pädagogik und Forschung sitzen bei uns an einem Tisch. Ehrlichkeit statt Hochglanz: Vieles bauen wir zum ersten Mal. Wenn dich das reizt, sollten wir reden. Was wir bieten Verantwortung ab Tag eins: Du bekommst echte Themen und Probleme statt Tickets, und deine Entscheidungen haben Gewicht. Top Arbeitsmaterial: Du arbeitest mit dem Setup und den Tools, die du brauchst. Flexible Weiterbildung: Konferenz, Kurs oder Workshop - du sagst uns, was dich weiterbringt. Hybrid mit Herz: Remote, wenn du Ruhe brauchst, und im Office, wenn wir gemeinsam tüfteln. Über die Rolle Unser erstes Produkt ist Onoo: ein kleiner, bildschirmfreier KI-Freund, der Kindern zwischen 4 und 9 ihre Warum-Fragen beantwortet. Der Prototyp funktioniert, der Launch ist 2027. Jetzt brauchen wir jemanden, der Onoo in die Köpfe und Wohnzimmer von Eltern bringt. Du bist unsere erste Marketing-Person, mit Platz am Gründer

title: Executive Assistant
description:
📍 MANCHESTER, UK (HYBRID 1 DAY WFH) | 💰 £50,000 - £55,000

Street Group is a fast moving B2B SaaS business - grown in Manchester but on a UK wide mission to make moving house as easy as buying a car. We’ve recently raised strategic growth investment, and are scaling fast toward an ambitious growth plan - and we’re looking for an experienced Executive Assistant to support our Co-CEOs, so they can spend their time on growing the business.

This is an opportunity for someone to join a scaling business during one of our most exciting chapters yet, and to build close relationships with Founders who both value and reward excellence.

If you are organised, trustworthy, and dependable, and know what separates exceptional EAs from good ones - we think you might do great work here.

HOW YOU’LL MAKE A DIFFERENCE

- You make sure the Co-CEOs are spending their time on things that only they can do. You run their diaries and inboxes, delegate work where possible, and say no to people when a day is already full.

- You’ll make sure meetings with them are worth having - e.g. there's a defined agendas, people turn up prepared, and actions get followed up on. Before board and investor meetings, you’ll make sure they know the numbers and what’s in the board pack.

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR

- You’re an experienced EA, have worked with a CEO or founder before and understand the appropriate level of support for stakeholders at this level.

- You’re super organised, and can juggle requests coming in from multiple people with different ways of working.

- You’re trustworthy and reliable.

- You have exceptional attention to detail.

- You can build good relationships with people, and are able to say no to protect the founder’s diaries without souring relationships.

- Bonus points if you’re comfortable using AI tools - but it won’t rule you out!

WHY YOU MIGHT NOT WANT TO APPLY

We'd rather be honest up front, because this role won't be for everyone.

- If you'd rather work for one person. You'll be balancing two founders' priorities, plus travel for our senior leaders - so you’ll be juggling different requirements and ways of working.

- If you want to work mostly from home. This role is 4 days a week in our Manchester office, so you're on hand when people need you.

If that sounds like your kind of role, please apply and let us know why!

We’re an award-winning PropTech business based in Manchester, founded in 2015 by brother and sister duo, Tom & Heather Staff. Most of us have personal experience of how painful moving can be, and Tom and Heather saw an opportunity to change this: utilising technology, as well as our incredibly talented team, to improve the industry for everyone.

title: Sr. Advisor AI Transformation & Automation Brand Marketing (f/m/d)
description:
About IONOS

At IONOS, we don't just manage servers - we shape the digital future for more than 6.2 million customers worldwide with our solutions. As Europe's leading hosting provider and a pioneer in independent cloud solutions, we are building next-generation infrastructure - from sovereign cloud architectures and high-performance GPU clusters to integrated AI automation tools.

What drives us is digital sovereignty for Europe and real impact for small and medium-sized businesses (SMBs) as well as large enterprises. We work in agile teams, rely on transparent structures, and believe that excellence and innovation only emerge through true team spirit.

Ready for your next step? Become part of IONOS and grow with us.

We are rebuilding our brand marketing AI-first: campaign, content, social, media, design, PR and events work with AI as the standard tool from brief to finished asset. You are the technical builder and AI-Ops owner behind it: you own workflows end-to-end, from context through agent design to evaluation, and raise them step by step to more automation. You come from brand marketing yourself and build the automation for work you know first-hand.

Tasks

• You analyse the core processes in brand marketing (briefing, production, adaptation, localisation, testing, reporting, approvals), break down time-consuming steps with low judgement needs and rebuild them with AI agents, with clear targets for autonomy and quality.

• You develop and run agents and automations on platforms such as Claude, n8n or comparable tools (asset variants, localisation, versioning, reporting, approval logic) and take every agent live with a baseline and metrics: benefit, usage, cost.

• You connect our systems (Looker, Google Workspace, DAM, ad platforms, CRM) and open up new data sources for the agents together with IT.

• You curate the context agents need (brand guidelines, templates, campaign history, test results, prompt library) and keep the knowledge sources in Drive and DAM current and cleanly structured.

• You define quality standards and eval routines so that hallucinations, prompt drift and stale data surface early, and optimise prompts and agents through user feedback and A/B tests. You set the guardrails together with Legal and Design.

• You translate requirements from Campaign, Content, Media, Design, PR and Event into technical solutions, bring Marketing, IT, Legal and Product together and raise AI fluency in the team: you train, document and are the first point of contact.

• You make success measurable on existing numbers (time per asset, cost per asset, output per FTE, quality, time to market) and derive the next automation steps from that.

Qualifications

• A brand marketing background is a prerequisite: at least 6 years in campaign, content, media or creative, in-house or agency-side. You have produced, adapted or run campaigns yourself and know briefing, production, localisation, testing and approvals from your own work.

• For AI workflows and agents we prioritise potential over tenure: quick grasp, product mindset, judgement. Apply even if your profile does not cover every point.

• Learning speed and production thinking: you have worked your way into a new technical field from scratch and built something real that people actually used, and you can say precisely what went wrong (hallucinations, prompt drift, stale data, cost) and how you fixed it.

• Evaluation instinct: "looks good" is not enough for you. You define a quality bar and measure against it.

• Ownership and communication: you take a problem end-to-end, prioritise hard, are comfortable with ambiguity and explain technical matters so that creative and media planning understand them.

• Tech and data: you read and adapt scripts, understand APIs, webhooks and MCP, build with n8n, Make or comparable tools and know how data from Looker, ad platforms and DAM flows into AI systems. Python or JavaScript and agent frameworks (e.g. Claude Agent SDK, LangChain) ar

- Provide training and enablement to internal stakeholders on legal issues and contract processes, and mentor more junior members of the Legal team.

- Help maintain and update our legal agreements, policies, and templates; develop and improve scalable workflows to enable rapid revenue growth and stability for the company.

- Experience negotiating on customer paper and working with negotiation playbooks and fallback positions is a plus.

title: Product Manager Agile Dev
description:

•
Product Management & Execution

• Collaborate with the Group Product Manager to understand strategic priorities and translate them into actionable product plans.

• Manage the product backlog for assigned features or modules; write user stories and acceptance criteria.

• Participate in Agile ceremonies to ensure timely delivery of high-quality features.

• Conduct discovery activities to gather user feedback and identify improvement opportunities.

• Track and report on product performance metrics; recommend enhancements based on data insights.

• Analyze and optimize user funnels to improve conversion rates and overall product performance.

•
Customer & Market Focus

• Advocate for the voice of the customer by conducting qualitative and quantitative research.

• Monitor industry trends and competitor offerings to inform product decisions.

•
Stakeholder & Vendor Collaboration

• Work closely with internal business units to gather requirements and align priorities.

• Coordinate with vendor partners to clarify requirements, support implementation, and resolve issues.

•
Communication & Reporting

• Provide regular updates on product progress, timelines, and risks to the Group Product Manager and other stakeholders.

• Document product requirements and maintain clear communication across teams.

Performance Expectations

• Perform responsibilities as directed achieving desired results within expected time frames and with a high degree of quality and professionalism.

• Establish and maintain positive and productive work relationships with all staff, customers, and business partners.

• Demonstrate the behavioral and technical competencies necessary to effectively complete job responsibilities. Take personal initiative for technical and professional development.

Qualifications

Experience:

• Experience with prototyping and A/B testing preferred.

Knowledge and Skills:
